items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: I sang with Carmen, with Sarah and Ella... 'Party Blues' with Ella, and 'Too Close for Comfort.' Stuff we did for the 1957 Metronome All-Stars.

ctx.x: God, you know I sang with Carmen, with Sarah and Ella—
Right, yes. Did you sing with Ella on recordings?
